resources.string:
1. Answer all questions within the time limit.
 2. Each correct answer earns points, wrong answers may result in penalties.
 3. Some questions may have multiple correct answers. Select all correct options.
 4. Use lifelines wisely. They are limited.
 5. Review your answers before submitting. Once submitted, they cannot be changed.
 6. Enjoy the quiz and challenge yourself to beat your high score!
